material.acceptance_criteria: CI job green on the pushed sha; guest builds for wasm32-wasip3 on nightly; host prints one wasip3 line with units>0 or the build-ok line with bytes=<n>.
material.description: Add rust/crates/wasip3 (own [workspace] root, excluded from rust/Cargo.toml like wasip1): guest package wasip3-guest, command protocol identical to wasip1 guest, WIT copy in wit/ for oscraft:wasip3. Native host bin oscraft_wasip3 prints 'wasip3 tick ok ticks=10 units=<n>' if wasmtime can instantiate, else 'wasip3 build ok bytes=<n>' and names the gap. ci.yml: one appended job building wasm32-wasip3 on nightly. Ownership: rust/crates/wasip3, one exclude line in rust/Cargo.toml, one appended ci.yml job.
